ranged_attack.name: Steel Darts
ranged_attack.windup: sets her feet, turns her shoulders and cocks her right hand back above her shoulder at {target}, three steel darts glowing white-hot between her fingers
ranged_attack.release: snaps her arm forward and the darts leave her hand as three blazing white streaks of light
ranged_attack.travel: the three glowing darts shoot across the courtyard like tiny comets, leaving long bright white trails
ranged_attack.impact: they slam into {target} in three bright bursts of white sparks and flying splinters
ranged_attack.decay: the white sparks vanish in an instant, leaving {target} clear
ranged_attack.again: snaps her arm forward again and throws three more blazing white darts that burst into sparks against {target} and vanish at once
ranged_attack.text: cocks her hand back and snaps her arm out at {target}, throwing three white-hot darts that streak like tiny comets and burst into bright white sparks on it that vanish at once

melee_attack.name: Palm Strike
melee_attack.windup: steps in low and draws her right hand back to her hip, palm open and glowing faint jade green
melee_attack.impact: her glowing palm snaps into {target} with a sharp crack and a bright ring of jade-green light, her coat flaring
melee_attack.decay: the jade light fades at once
melee_attack.recover: pulls her hand back into a guarded stance
melee_attack.again: lands another fast palm strike on {target} in a bright ring of jade-green light that fades at once
melee_attack.text: draws her hand back to her hip and shoots a fast open-palm strike into {target} in a bright ring of jade-green light that fades at once

dash.name: Shadow Step
dash.text: darts forward in a blur, her green coat flaring and a faint glowing trail behind her
